==Biography==
On January 21, 2013, all of Linak's accounts were permanently banned from League of Legends due to toxic behavior. He was subsequently suspended from the [[Riot Season 3 Championship Series/Europe/Qualifiers/Main Event|Riot Season 3 EU Live Qualifier]] as well as from the [[Riot League Championship Series/Europe/Season 3|Riot Championship Series]] for one year.<ref>[http://euw.leagueoflegends.com/board/showthread.php?p=10143141#10143141 eSports Competition Rulings: Suspensions of mouz enVision and aAa linak] ''euw.leagueoflegends.com''</ref> His ban was extended by one year on November 7, 2013, due to not improving his toxic behavior during his period of ineligibility.<ref>[http://forums.na.leagueoflegends.com/board/showthread.php?p=42839000#42839000 eSports Competition Rulings: Suspensions of Linak and Rayt3ch] ''na.leagueoflegends.com''</ref>
